RUTHLESS is a small scale, off Broadway musical from 1992 by Joel Paley and Marvin Laird, with just 6 characters, all of them female, one played by a man in drag.

cn.t: This campy musical parody of showbiz ambition divides critics: some enjoy its gleefully over-the-top performances and theatrical in-jokes, while others find it overly schlocky and patchy, with humor that depends heavily on your tolerance for camp excess.
